summary: Build governance, reporting, and leadership skills for cyber risk oversight. Learn practical frameworks and create board-ready outputs.
lede: Cybersecurity governance helps security leaders and risk professionals oversee controls, assess cyber risk, and communicate priorities clearly. This training develops practical skills in building risk registers, mapping controls to responsibilities, assessing governance maturity, structuring security policies, designing board dashboards, and setting escalation workflows, including for cloud and third-party oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to govern cybersecurity programs, lead security teams, and report security risk with clarity.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, basic IT governance, and organizational risk management. Experience in security operations, audit, compliance, or IT leadership is recommended, but no programming is required. Familiarity with dashboards, policy documents, and board reporting materials will help you complete the applied exercises more efficiently. Advanced governance topics are taught at an operational application level, with AI-supported monitoring introduced conceptually only.
